summary: The one authorized final-test access event was consumed by vedant_infra.g3.guarded_test_access, but the guarded loader crashed with an engineering defect before reading any test-partition row, before any model inference, and before any metric/bootstrap/sensitivity/error-analysis computation. Per the retry policy frozen pre-access in configs/final_test_v1.json (stage5_final_test_retry_policy_v1), no exact-resume mechanism exists in this codebase capable of proving identical run continuation, so the run fails closed. No repair-and-rerun, reset, or second access event was attempted.

root_cause.defect: load_frozen_models() re-invoked vedant_infra.g3.validate_g3_marker(expected_scope='real') from inside the guarded loader callback. vedant_infra.g3.guarded_test_access() already performs that exact validation immediately before it marks FINAL_TEST_ACCESS_CONSUMED and flips test_access_state to FINAL_RUN_COMPLETED, then invokes the loader. Because validate_g3_marker's internal audit_g3(..., allow_authorized_state=True) only tolerates test_access_state in {NEVER_OPENED, INVALIDATED_BY_RESET, AUTHORIZED_NOT_RUN}, the loader's redundant second call always fails once access has legitimately transitioned to FINAL_RUN_COMPLETED a moment earlier in the very same guarded invocation.
root_cause.exception: vedant_infra.g3.G3FreezeError: G3 dependencies no longer satisfy prerequisite audit (nonuse_check: 'test was already authorized or consumed')

retry_policy_applied.reason: No same-run exact-resume mechanism exists in the codebase to prove identical run identity/configuration/artifacts/access-history continuation. An ordinary second guarded_test_access invocation would be indistinguishable from a forbidden second scientific exposure, since vedant_infra.g3.guarded_test_access unconditionally rejects any access_state other than AUTHORIZED_NOT_RUN.
retry_policy_applied.human_authorization_required_for: Any formal reset (vedant_infra.g3.invalidate_for_reset) and re-freeze of G3 to obtain a fresh, single authorized final-test exposure is an extraordinary governance action outside the scope delegated for Stage 5 implementation-parameter decisions, and is not performed by this record.
